sections.title: How this item benefits the environment
sections.html: This supplement helps control livestock, protects environmental features and manage habitats on difficult sites.

sections.title: Where you can use this supplement
sections.html:
You can use this item with the agreement of Natural England or the Forestry Commission in combination with either:

FG1: Fencing

FG2: Sheep netting

FG3: Permanent electric fencing

FG7: Anti-predator combination fencing

FG8: Anti-predator temporary electric fencing

FG9: Deer fencing

You can also use in a Higher Tier capital grant in combination with:

FG7: Anti-predator combination fencing

FG8: Anti-predator temporary electric fencing

FG9: Deer fencing

You can also use in a Woodland Tree Health Grant in combination with either:

FG1: Fencing

FG2: Sheep netting

FG9: Deer fencing

TE5: Supplement for use of individual tree-shelters (with the agreement of the Forestry Commission)

sections.title: What you must do to use this supplement
sections.html:
You must:

  • agree a specification for the works with Natural England or the Forestry Commission
  • complete the works in the agreed specification to the relevant standard and timescale

Your adviser will adapt the requirements for this item to your site. You should discuss and agree these requirements with them.

sections.title: Evidence you must keep
sections.html:
You must keep photographs of the completed work and provide with your claim.

You must also keep and provide on request:

  • any consents or permissions connected with the work
  • receipted invoices or bank statements where a receipted invoice is unavailable
  • photographs of the existing site before work starts

Read the record keeping and site visit requirements in the Agreement holder’s guide: Capital Grants, Higher Tier capital grants and Protection and Infrastructure grants for more information.

If you’re applying for this item as part of a Countryside Stewardship Higher Tier (CSHT) application, you must read the record keeping and site visit requirements in the CSHT agreement holder’s guide.

sections.title: Advice to help you use this supplement
sections.html:
The following advice may help you to use this supplement, but you do not have to follow it to get paid. It’s not part of this supplement’s requirements. 

Picking the right location

Use this supplement if the site you’re going to fence:

  • is remote
  • cannot be accessed by vehicles
  • is on steep slopes
  • is prone to flooding or waterlogged for large parts of the year
  • needs a lot of ground preparation

This item is part of Higher Tier Capital Grants 2026. You must read the Higher Tier Capital Grants 2026 guidance to understand the rules and how to apply.

If you’re applying for this item as part of a Countryside Stewardship Higher Tier (CSHT) application, you must read the CSHT applicant’s guide to understand the rules and how to apply.

How much you’ll be paid 

£3.98 per metre (m).

How this item benefits the environment

This supplement helps control livestock, protects environmental features and manage habitats on difficult sites.

Where you can use this supplement

FG1: Fencing

FG9: Deer fencing

TE5: Supplement for use of individual tree-shelters (with the agreement of the Forestry Commission)

What you must do to use this supplement

You must:

  • agree a specification for the works with Natural England or the Forestry Commission
  • complete the works in the agreed specification to the relevant standard and timescale

Your adviser will adapt the requirements for this item to your site. You should discuss and agree these requirements with them. 

Evidence you must keep 

You must keep photographs of the completed work and provide with your claim.

You must also keep and provide on request:

  • any consents or permissions connected with the work
  • receipted invoices or bank statements where a receipted invoice is unavailable
  • photographs of the existing site before work starts

Read the record keeping and site visit requirements in the Agreement holder’s guide: Capital Grants, Higher Tier capital grants and Protection and Infrastructure grants for more information.

If you’re applying for this item as part of a Countryside Stewardship Higher Tier (CSHT) application, you must read the record keeping and site visit requirements in the CSHT agreement holder’s guide.

Advice to help you use this supplement

The following advice may help you to use this supplement, but you do not have to follow it to get paid. It’s not part of this supplement’s requirements. 

Picking the right location

Use this supplement if the site you’re going to fence:
